newsitem.title: GERMANY: Linotype-Hell says chief executive to quit.
newsitem.headline: Linotype-Hell says chief executive to quit.

text.p: Germany's Linotype-Hell AG said on Monday its chief executive Erwin Koenigs will leave the company on October 31 and be a replaced by an executive from the company's new owner, Heidelberger Druckmaschinen AG.
Bernhard Schreier, a member of the management board at Heidelberger Druckmaschinen, will take over at Linotype on November 1, Linotype said in a statement.
Linotype's supervisory board had accepted Koenigs' request to resign, the statement said.

Heidelberger Druck, a subsidiary of electricity group Rheinelektra AG, is in the process of buying a stake of more than 75 percent in Linotype, which makes image setters and electronic colour systems.
The deal has yet to be approved by the Federal Cartel Office.
